title: Night runner: execute an approved plan sequentially with the end-time guard (failing test first)
goal: Runs the plan unattended and safely
acceptance: Owner request 2026-11-26 in the consumer session (𖣂 nerv): "maybe useful to suggest, planning for nights run"; nerv runs campaigns through tools/gauntlet.mjs and is the first consumer.

A committed failing test first, then a runner that takes only an approved plan file, runs stages one at a time, checks before each that the stage's estimate still ends before the window end and skips with a reason otherwise, unloads the model (Ollama) or frees the generator (ComfyUI) after each stage, and stops cleanly on a failed stage while recording it
Writes one report per stage and never writes the ledger; the owner merges reports after review with gauntlet ledger
Tested with a fake clock and a fake runtime adapter: guard skip, failure stop, unload called between stages, no ledger change

The runner refuses to start a stage whose runtime start check failed, waits for the previous stage by its exit status and report, gives the first case a cold-start allowance, and asks the consumer's unload hook (nerv F-144 keep-alive) before the first stage; each tested on fake runtimes
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; reports and plans hold no personal text.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
